Name: For in-depth Damage Stacking info, check out Court's Modifier Database
Description:
Reload Perk Notes:

Generate = Grants Ammo to Magazine out of thin air, up to its Base Magazine Size. Does not work with Overflown Magazines.

Overflow = Increases Base Magazine Capacity by a certain amount, rounded up.

Refill = Reload, but does not have an animation and doesn't proc on-reload perks. Pulls from reserves on Special and Power Weapons.
For Heat Weapons, it will instead be "Dissipates X Heat" to discern it from manual venting

Reload = Procs on-reload perks. Manual Reload, Marksman's Dodge, and Dragon's Shadow all count as regular reloads.
For Heat Weapons, finishing a manual vent will count as a regular reload.
